title: Tips APIs
description: Tips APIs enable merchants to integrate tipping functionality directly into the payment terminals. These APIs provide options for adding either preset or custom tip amounts to the overall payment amount on the terminal screen. When customers make payments, they can choose from these displayed preset tip values or decide to enter a custom amount based on their preference. Tips can be configured at the merchant, store, or terminal levels, allowing for flexibility to match your unique operational requirements.

apis.heading: Set Merchant Tips Config
apis.description: Sets the merchant-level tips configuration inherited by all stores and terminals registered to the merchant. Use this API to apply the same tips configuration across every terminal associated with a merchant.

reqParams.name: tipConfig
reqParams.description: Specifies how tips are managed during the payment. The possible values are the following:

possibleValues.description: Allows the terminal to display preset tip options while accepting payments.
Hides the tip option so the terminal shows no tip prompts during payment.

Lets the customer enter a free custom tip amount on the tips screen. Equivalent to sending tipConfig: ENABLED with freeAmountEnabled: true. When the configuration is read back it is reported as tipConfig: ENABLED with freeAmountEnabled: true, not as OTHER_AMOUNT.

reqParams.name: tipLevel1
reqParams.description: The first preset tip option shown to the customer, interpreted as a percentage or a fixed amount according to tipDisplayFormat.

reqParams.name: tipLevel2
reqParams.description: The second preset tip option shown to the customer, interpreted as a percentage or a fixed amount according to tipDisplayFormat.

reqParams.name: tipLevel3
reqParams.description: The third preset tip option shown to the customer, interpreted as a percentage or a fixed amount according to tipDisplayFormat.

reqParams.name: defaultCustomAmount
reqParams.description: The value pre-filled on the screen for the custom tip amount.

reqParams.name: displayCalculatedAmount
reqParams.description: Specifies whether the calculated tip amount is shown on screen.

possibleValues.description: Shows the calculated tip amount.
Hides the calculated tip amount.

reqParams.name: tipDisplayFormat
reqParams.description: The format in which the preset tip levels are displayed.

possibleValues.description: Displays preset tip levels as percentages.
Displays preset tip levels as fixed amounts.

reqParams.name: maxCustomTipAmount
reqParams.description: The maximum tip amount a customer can enter for a custom tip.

reqParams.name: freeAmountEnabled
reqParams.description: Only meaningful when tipConfig is ENABLED: setting it to true switches the configuration to OTHER_AMOUNT, letting the customer enter a custom tip amount on the tips screen. It has no effect when tipConfig is DISABLED and is not stored as an independent field (equivalent to sending tipConfig: OTHER_AMOUNT).

resParams.name: status
resParams.description: Status of the request, indicated as either 'SUCCESS' or 'ERROR'.

resParams.name: message
resParams.description: A message that describes the status of the request.

apis.heading: Fetch Merchant Tips Config
apis.description: Retrieves the merchant-level tips configuration inherited by all terminals registered to the merchant. Use this API to get the tips configuration applied across the merchant.

resParams.name: status
resParams.description: Status of the request, indicated as either 'SUCCESS' or 'ERROR'.

resParams.name: data
resParams.description: Response data.

resParams.name: tipConfig
resParams.description: Specifies how tips are managed during payment. Always returned as ENABLED or DISABLED; a configuration stored as OTHER_AMOUNT is normalized to ENABLED here and surfaced separately through the freeAmountEnabled flag (which is true in that case).

possibleValues.description: Allows the terminal to display preset tip options while accepting payments.
Hides the tip option so the terminal shows no tip prompts during payment.

resParams.name: tipLevel1
resParams.description: The first preset tip option shown to the customer, interpreted as a percentage or a fixed amount according to tipDisplayFormat.

resParams.name: tipLevel2
resParams.description: The second preset tip option shown to the customer, interpreted as a percentage or a fixed amount according to tipDisplayFormat.

resParams.name: tipLevel3
resParams.description: The third preset tip option shown to the customer, interpreted as a percentage or a fixed amount according to tipDisplayFormat.

resParams.name: defaultCustomAmount
resParams.description: The value pre-filled on the screen for the custom tip amount.

resParams.name: displayCalculatedAmount
resParams.description: Specifies whether the calculated tip amount is shown on screen.

possibleValues.description: Shows the calculated tip amount.
Hides the calculated tip amount.

resParams.name: tipDisplayFormat
resParams.description: The format in which the preset tip levels are displayed.

possibleValues.description: Displays preset tip levels as percentages.
Displays preset tip levels as fixed amounts.

resParams.name: freeAmountEnabled
resParams.description: True when the stored tips configuration is OTHER_AMOUNT (the customer can enter a custom tip amount); otherwise false. Derived directly from tipConfig, so it always accompanies a normalized tipConfig of ENABLED.

resParams.name: message
resParams.description: A message that describes the status of the request.
